lede: Michigan carries the stronger underlying team rating — +5.4 against +2.1, a 3.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Michigan -1.7 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Michigan winning 54% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is special teams, where Iowa leads Michigan by 50 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 74% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
